The taxonomy's needs-info bucket names "a broken/missing plan link" as its own example, so I'm routing there rather than guessing either that the rule doesn't apply (and calling it ready-to-implement) or that it's simply unspecced (ready-to-spec, which doesn't fit — nothing here needs decomposition).
